correctness.rationale: The finite birational map from smooth torus is normalizing since all source torus variables are integral over coordinate traces; the polynomial is monic degree 4 in a trace and has four generic distinct roots, hence is irreducible of total degree six. Equality-of-traces differs only by inversions; pairwise inversion yields exactly six lines, triple inversion is excluded by λ²≠1, and Jacobian rank drops only where two torus coordinates equal ±1. Detailed local tangent-normal determinant ±4 proves four ordinary triple crossings; exact logarithmic normal form gives 12 Whitney pinches; other double strata are transverse. Euler integration 0=χc(S)-18+8 gives χc(S)=10. The attached script checks identities, not the global theorem; source and proof steps are independently reconstructed.
